cards.text: Back in the garden, Peter swung a sword, and Jesus told him to put it away. Now the soldiers, their commander and the officers of the Jews arrest Jesus and bind Him. Friend, they tie up the One who just walked right up to them and said, “I am He.”

cards.question: The soldiers bring Jesus first to ___, the father-in-law of Caiaphas.

cards.text: Caiaphas is the high priest that year. And the text stops right here to remind us what Caiaphas once advised.

cards.question: What had Caiaphas, the high priest that year, advised the Jews?

answers.text: It would be better if one man died for the people
It would be better to send this man away
It would be better to keep this man quiet

cards.text: Meanwhile, Simon Peter and another disciple are following Jesus. That other disciple is known to the high priest, so he walks right into the high priest’s courtyard with Jesus. VIP access. No line, no wristband, nothing.

cards.question: True or false: Peter walks into the high priest’s courtyard right alongside the other disciple.

cards.text: Peter’s stuck outside at the door like a guy who forgot his work badge, until the other disciple talks to the doorkeeper and brings him in. Then the servant girl watching the door looks at Peter and asks, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?”

cards.question: How does Peter answer the servant girl at the door when she asks if he’s one of Jesus’ disciples?
Inside, the servants and officers stand around a charcoal fire they made, because it is ___.

cards.text: And who’s standing right there with them, warming himself? PETER. He just told the door he is NOT a disciple, and now he’s hanging around the fire, like calling in sick and then spending the whole day in the office break room.

cards.question: Meanwhile, the high priest questions Jesus about His ___ and His ___.

cards.text: Jesus answers him straight: “I have spoken openly to the world.” He taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together, and He says He said nothing in secret.

cards.question: Jesus said nothing in secret. So who does He tell the high priest to ask about what He said?

cards.text: That’s when one of the officers standing nearby slaps Jesus in the face. And he says, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”

cards.question: How does Jesus answer the officer who slapped Him?

answers.text: He asks why He was struck if He spoke correctly
He stays silent and looks away from him
He asks the high priest to have him removed

cards.text: Then Annas sends Jesus, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest. And back at the fire, Peter is STILL standing there warming himself, when they ask him if he’s one of Jesus’ disciples too.

cards.question: True or false: Standing by the fire, Peter finally admits he’s one of Jesus’ disciples.

cards.text: Then one of the high priest’s servants steps up, a relative of the man whose ear Peter cut off, and asks, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?” Friend, that’s like cutting somebody off in traffic and then walking into your job interview, and HE’S the one doing the interview.

cards.question: Peter denies it once more. What happens immediately after?

cards.text: Three denials, before the rooster crowed, just like Jesus told Peter back at supper (John 13:38). We’ll leave it right there for now, friend, but trust me, this story is NOT done.
